definitions.supplemental: Cf. O. H. Ger. ar-helzit, arlemit debilitatum.
definitions.meaning: To make to halt, to cripple a person's movement

quotations.old_english: Þá on hyge þóhtan þæt hí áhyltan mé and mínne gang

source_text: á-hiltan; p. te To make to halt, to cripple a person's movement :-- Þá on hyge þóhtan þæt hí áhyltan mé and mínne gang qui cogitaverunt supplantare gressus meos, Ps. Th. 139, 5. [Cf. O. H. Ger. ar-helzit, arlemit debilitatum.]
